description: Establish a green baseline. Install backend and frontend dependencies and run the existing test suites so later changes are measured against a known-good starting point.
steps: Backend deps: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt (use python3 -m pip if pip is unavailable). pytest is listed in requirements.txt.
Run backend tests: cd backend && python3 -m pytest tests/ -v. Record how many pass. All backend tests mock AIService, so no real AI key is needed.
Frontend deps: cd frontend && npm install.
Run frontend tests: cd frontend && npm test (vitest run). Record results.
Run frontend build: cd frontend && npm run build (tsc -b && vite build) to confirm the TypeScript project compiles cleanly.
Record the baseline pass/fail counts for both suites in this feature's findings field.
acceptance_criteria: Backend dependencies install successfully and `python3 -m pytest tests/ -v` runs to completion with a recorded pass count.
Frontend dependencies install and `npm test` runs to completion with a recorded pass count.
`npm run build` completes without TypeScript errors.
Baseline results are written to findings.
findings: Green baseline established on branch fix/workflow-usability. Backend: pip install -r requirements.txt succeeded (one non-fatal dep-resolver warning: awscli wants distro<1.9.0 but 1.9.0 installed; unrelated to app, tests unaffected). `python3 -m pytest tests/ -v` => 75 passed, 0 failed in ~8.3s. All backend tests mock AIService (no AI key needed). Frontend: npm install => up to date, 0 vulnerabilities. `npm test` (vitest run) => 21 passed across 4 files (KnowledgeBase 4, WorkflowStepper 6, PhaseContent 7, App 4), 0 failed. `npm run build` (tsc -b && vite build) => compiled cleanly, no TypeScript errors (dist bundle ~376.88 kB / gzip 118.36 kB). Toolchain: pytest 7.4.3, vitest 4.1.10, vite 8.2.1, Node 22, Python 3.11 (pip installed for python3.9 interpreter but tests run fine). No source files modified in this feature.
